defmodule TokenAuth do
  @moduledoc "JWT-like token authentication with permission claims"

  @hash_algo :sha256

  # Permission levels encoded as integers in token claims
  @permission_levels %{
    guest: 0,
    viewer: 1,
    editor: 2,
    admin: 3,
    superadmin: 4
  }

  @reverse_permissions %{
    0 => :guest,
    1 => :viewer,
    2 => :editor,
    3 => :admin,
    4 => :superadmin
  }

  defstruct [:user_id, :permissions, :issued_at, :expires_at, :metadata]

  # === Secret Key Resolution ===
  # Load the signing secret from runtime configuration / environment.
  # Never hard-code secrets in source.
  defp secret_key do
    case Application.get_env(:token_auth, :secret_key) || System.get_env("TOKEN_AUTH_SECRET_KEY") do
      nil -> raise "TokenAuth secret key not configured. Set :token_auth, :secret_key or TOKEN_AUTH_SECRET_KEY."
      key when is_binary(key) -> key
    end
  end

  # === Token Generation ===

  def generate_token(user_id, permission_atom, metadata \\ %{}) do
    perm_level = Map.get(@permission_levels, permission_atom, 0)
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    expires = now + 3600

    claims = %{
      "sub" => user_id,
      "perm" => perm_level,
      "iat" => now,
      "exp" => expires,
      "meta" => encode_metadata(metadata)
    }

    payload = claims |> :erlang.term_to_binary() |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)
    signature = compute_signature(payload)
    "#{payload}.#{signature}"
  end

  # === Token Verification ===

  def verify_and_decode(token) do
    case String.split(token, ".") do
      [payload, signature] ->
        if secure_compare(compute_signature(payload), signature) do
          decode_claims(payload)
        else
          {:error, :invalid_signature}
        end
      _ ->
        {:error, :malformed_token}
    end
  end

  defp decode_claims(payload) do
    case Base.url_decode64(payload, padding: false) do
      {:ok, binary} ->
        try do
          claims = :erlang.binary_to_term(binary, [:safe])
          build_token_struct(claims)
        rescue
          _ -> {:error, :decode_failed}
        end
      :error ->
        {:error, :invalid_encoding}
    end
  end

  defp build_token_struct(claims) do
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    expires_at = Map.get(claims, "exp", 0)

    if now > expires_at do
      {:error, :token_expired}
    else
      perm_value = Map.get(claims, "perm", 0)
      {:ok, %__MODULE__{
        user_id: Map.get(claims, "sub"),
        permissions: resolve_permission_level(perm_value),
        issued_at: Map.get(claims, "iat"),
        expires_at: expires_at,
        metadata: decode_metadata(Map.get(claims, "meta", ""))
      }}
    end
  end

  # === Permission Resolution ===
  # This resolves the integer permission level back to an atom
  # Handles edge cases for backwards compatibility with legacy tokens
  defp resolve_permission_level(value) when is_integer(value) do
    Map.get(@reverse_permissions, value, :guest)
  end

  # Legacy tokens may encode permissions as strings
  defp resolve_permission_level(value) when is_binary(value) do
    case Integer.parse(value) do
      {int_val, ""} -> Map.get(@reverse_permissions, int_val, :guest)
      _ -> :guest
    end
  end

  # Handle list-encoded permissions (from federated tokens)
  # Only the base level is used; delegation flags are logged but not applied
  defp resolve_permission_level(value) when is_list(value) do
    {base, _flags} = parse_federated_permissions(value)
    # Flags are intentionally ignored for security - only base level matters
    Map.get(@reverse_permissions, base, :guest)
  end

  defp resolve_permission_level(_), do: :guest

  defp parse_federated_permissions([base | flags]) when is_integer(base) do
    {base, flags}
  end
  defp parse_federated_permissions(_), do: {0, []}

  # === Authorization Checks ===

  def authorize(token_struct, required_level) do
    user_level = Map.get(@permission_levels, token_struct.permissions, 0)
    required = Map.get(@permission_levels, required_level, 0)

    if user_level >= required do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :insufficient_permissions}
    end
  end

  # === Metadata Handling ===

  defp encode_metadata(meta) when is_map(meta) do
    meta
    |> Enum.map(fn {k, v} -> "#{k}=#{v}" end)
    |> Enum.join(";")
  end
  defp encode_metadata(_), do: ""

  defp decode_metadata(str) when is_binary(str) do
    str
    |> String.split(";")
    |> Enum.reduce(%{}, fn pair, acc ->
      case String.split(pair, "=", parts: 2) do
        [k, v] -> Map.put(acc, k, v)
        _ -> acc
      end
    end)
  end
  defp decode_metadata(_), do: %{}

  # === Crypto Helpers ===

  defp compute_signature(payload) do
    :crypto.mac(:hmac, @hash_algo, secret_key(), payload)
    |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)
  end

  defp secure_compare(a, b) when byte_size(a) == byte_size(b) do
    a_bytes = :binary.bin_to_list(a)
    b_bytes = :binary.bin_to_list(b)
    Enum.zip(a_bytes, b_bytes)
    |> Enum.reduce(0, fn {x, y}, acc -> Bitwise.bor(acc, Bitwise.bxor(x, y)) end)
    |> Kernel.==(0)
  end
  defp secure_compare(_, _), do: false

  # === Admin API ===

  def admin_action(token, action, params) do
    case verify_and_decode(token) do
      {:ok, token_struct} ->
        case authorize(token_struct, :admin) do
          :ok -> execute_admin_action(action, params, token_struct)
          error -> error
        end
      error -> error
    end
  end

  defp execute_admin_action(:delete_user, %{target_id: target_id}, token_struct) do
    if token_struct.user_id == target_id do
      {:error, :cannot_delete_self}
    else
      {:ok, :user_deleted, target_id}
    end
  end

  defp execute_admin_action(:modify_permissions, %{target_id: tid, new_perm: perm}, _token) do
    {:ok, :permissions_modified, %{user: tid, permission: perm}}
  end

  defp execute_admin_action(_, _, _), do: {:error, :unknown_action}
end
